overview_description.description:
Your company uses several IaaS and SaaS products. This comes with the complexity of Multi-Cloud, Multi-Accounts, Multi-Regions, Multi-Teams thereby increasing Operational complexity. In addition, these tools also require 24x7 attention for Security, Compliance, Drift, Cost Management and Data Leakages. With Cloudanix, your team gets both single view + remediation workflows to operate in the digital world.

Cloudanix becomes your Central Dashboard for your Cloud-Ops, Engineering and InfoSec teams to collaborate together.

identifier.value: Cloudanix Code to Cloud Security Platform

product.name: Cloudanix Code to Cloud Security Platform
product.description: A cloud-native platform that integrates security across code, CI pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and identities with a unified dashboard for compliance, remediation, and threat detection.

product.name: Cloudanix Just-In-Time (JIT) Access Management
product.description: A feature that manages cloud identity and access by providing just-in-time permissions, least privilege enforcement, and identity governance to reduce risks from over-provisioned access.

product.name: Cloudanix Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
product.description: A service that continuously monitors cloud environments for misconfigurations, compliance violations, and threats, providing remediation playbooks and real-time alerts.

product.name: Cloudanix Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP)
product.description: A platform securing containerized workloads by covering image security, configuration, and runtime threat detection across Kubernetes and other environments.

identifier.value: Cloudanix Shift Left Security for Code

product.name: Cloudanix Shift Left Security for Code
product.description: A security service that integrates with source code repositories and CI pipelines to detect and remediate vulnerabilities and secrets before code reaches production.

identifier.value: Cloudanix Compliance Reporting and Audit Automation

product.name: Cloudanix Compliance Reporting and Audit Automation
product.description: A service that automates compliance audits and generates reports aligned with industry standards to support regulatory requirements.
